title: Dragon in Abandoned Village
description: A large green dragon with blue eyes and a grey scarf sits atop the wooden frame of a ruined house in an overgrown, misty valley. In the background, additional dilapidated houses dot the green hills under a pale sun and foggy sky, with scrap metal and wildflowers in the foreground.
prompt: A large emerald green dragon with bright blue eyes and a striped grey scarf sits on the skeletal wooden roof of a ruined house. The dragon looks upward with a curious expression. The scene is set in a misty, overgrown valley with several other dilapidated wooden houses on green hills in the background. Foreground shows scrap metal, wildflowers and tall grass. Soft foggy atmosphere with a pale sun in a pale sky, fantasy illustration style.
